signatures.name: above_chance_recall
signatures.description: Overall recall accuracy is significantly above the typed-3-letters chance baseline (1/26^3 ~ 0.00006, conservatively rounded up to 0.05 to account for any natural overlap in 3-letter prefixes within the stimulus pool).

signatures.name: similarity_aids_recall
signatures.description: Recall accuracy increases with semantic similarity of the cue-target pair (Haridi & Schulz Memory Festival; the central similarity-aids-recall finding).

signatures.name: high_vs_low_sim_advantage
signatures.description: Recall accuracy on highly similar pairs (similarity 0.8) significantly exceeds accuracy on dissimilar pairs (similarity 0.2).

signatures.name: similarity_rt_effect
signatures.description: Recall latency falls as cue-target semantic similarity rises: a more strongly associated cue retrieves its target faster.
